Crucially, the transaction was made from a device (Trident/7.0, Windows 7, ie 11.0 for desktop) that the customer has used previously, reducing the likelihood of unauthorized access. Furthermore, no rapid transaction sequence was observed, which often accompanies fraudulent activity. Without direct customer confirmation, it is impossible to definitively determine whether this transaction is legitimate or fraudulent. The ambiguity of the "Large shared-card network" flag further contributes to the uncertainty, as its significance without additional context on the nature of these related transactions is unclear.
